summary: hunterone-build-probe-9210 exfiltrates Lambda build artifacts and process environment to webhook.site on install
details: The package declares preinstall and postinstall hooks that execute probe.js on npm install. probe.js enumerates and reads files under /var/task (including package.json, functions.json, routes.json, and handlers/*), reads /proc/2/environ and extracts AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME and AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_GROUP values from another process, and POSTs the collected data to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (webhook.site/22508080-b099-4ec3-8ab7-7354af2886a9/buildenv3). Behavior fires automatically at install with no caller opt-in, and the destination is a third-party inspection service under the publisher's control rather than any documented build infrastructure. The self-described bug-bounty / probe framing does not match the observed data flow.
